seasonseries.title: San Jose Earthquakes vs. Portland Timbers

keyEvents.text: Goal! San Jose Earthquakes 1, Portland Timbers 0. Preston Judd (San Jose Earthquakes) header from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Eduard Löwen with a cross.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Goal! San Jose Earthquakes 2, Portland Timbers 0. Eduard Löwen (San Jose Earthquakes) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Beau Leroux.
Goal! San Jose Earthquakes 3, Portland Timbers 0. Preston Judd (San Jose Earthquakes) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Paul Marie.
Preston Judd (San Jose Earthquakes) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Reid Roberts (San Jose Earthquakes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, San Jose Earthquakes 3, Portland Timbers 0.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Benji Kikanovic replaces Paul Marie.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Nick Fernandez replaces Timo Werner.
Substitution, Portland Timbers. Ian Smith replaces Jimer Fory.
